**Deferred behind #18314, which I dispatched this round** (claim 5725782443). #18314's remedy is to lift the proxy re-exec pattern **out of** `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` into `scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs`; this card **edits** that donor file.

That is a read-versus-write overlap, not a write-versus-write conflict, so I could have run them together. I chose not to: the honest reading of the serial rule is "拿不准就串行", and a dev copying a pattern out of a file while another dev rewrites that file's imperative remedy text is exactly the kind of coupling the merge queue would catch late. ⛔ #18314's dev is fenced read-only on this file and has been told so explicitly.

**Waits on: #18314's PR landing.**

**Re-check before dispatch:** read #18314's landed diff first. If it extracted a **shared helper** rather than making a 4th verbatim copy, this card's file may no longer hold the pattern at all and the hardcoded-comment-id remedy text may have moved — so re-locate the defect on the tree before writing a dispatch. ⛔ Do not inherit the line reference from this card's filing.

My deferral note asked specifically: *if #18314 extracted a shared helper rather than making a 4th verbatim copy, this card's file may no longer hold the pattern and the remedy text may have moved.* It **did** take the helper route — so that was the right question. The answer is still clean:

**Answer: UNAFFECTED, and no coordinate drift.**

Readings (mine, 07:27Z on `origin/main`):
- `16cb493d` changed **exactly one file** — `scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs`, `+122 / -1`. ⇒ **this card's file was never touched**, only imported from.
- This card's subject is intact: `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs:387` still prints `Clause-②-correction: 5642248126` in the imperative, and `:1333` still documents why that is the defect — "5642248126 resolves to `/issues/17366` while the card under test was #17425". Control lit (the file reads 9132 lines, so the hits are not an empty-file artefact).
- The donor still carries `proxyRearmPlan` (2 hits), i.e. #18935 imported the decision and left the performer here alone.

⇒ Line references in this card are **still valid** — unlike #18629, whose file moved +165 lines. Claiming it now.

## Resolved by

Verified by me on `origin/main`, ⛔ not taken from the report: `correctionRemedy(target)` is now **a function of the card under test** — with no readable id it prints the key carrying *no digits* ("followed by the numeric id of the claim comment it corrects, digits only"); otherwise it interpolates `${id}` and says it is "read from card #${target.card}'s own thread". ⇒ The remedy can no longer print a constant, which is exactly the shape this card asked for.

⇒ Three passes after the fix existed, and none of them caught it.

## ⭐ My own reading was wrong, and the way it was wrong is worth more than this card

I wrote in the dispatch that `:387` "carries, **inside a printed prescription**, the literal `Clause-②-correction: 5642248126`". The literal is there — but **it sits inside the file's `/** */` header doc-block**, every line ` * `-prefixed, as a worked specimen of the shape. I re-read `:378-392` myself and confirm it. It is printed by nothing: 0 occurrences under `--help`, 0 on the own-card `--pair` run.

⚠️ **And this card's own proposed shape sanctions that hit** — it asked to keep the literal *only in the doc-block and the self-test*, which is precisely the state of the tree today. So the grep hit I treated as the defect was the evidence of the **fix**.

**The general lesson, which is the part I want carried forward:**

> **A grep hit on a literal is evidence that the literal exists — never that anything prints it.**

My discipline already demands a lit control for a **zero** ("零命中须配同主体必中词"). It demands nothing symmetric for a **hit**. Triage, my deferral note and my unblock note each re-derived a count and a line number, each got a hit, and each concluded the defect was live; **none asked whether the hit was on a reachable printed path or inside a comment.** On today's tree all 13 occurrences are in doc-blocks, `//` comments or self-test fixtures — and **6 of them are assertions that the specimen must NOT appear**, i.e. six of my "evidence" hits were the fix's own regression pins.

⛔ I am not recording this as a one-off slip: the same shape would have fooled the next seat. Filing it to the `domain:skills` lane as a principle gap.

## Fences and hygiene

File surface never breached — this file was read-only, `check-widening-tells.mjs` never opened, exports and proxy handling untouched. `mcp_calls` **0**; **1** REST write of 3 budgeted (report comment only; `POST /pulls` and the label write correctly unspent). Worktree removed clean, `HEAD == BASE`.

The empty probe branch `claude/issue-18376-clause2-carriers-hardcoded-comment-id` (0 commits, no PR) is **left in place**: my claim comment names it, and `AGENTS.md` tolerates an empty head explicitly ("a hit is a hint, not a claim"). ⛔ Deleting a ref my own record points at buys nothing.

## The sibling sweep came back negative — recorded so nobody re-runs it

I asked the dev to check whether other prescriptions print copyable literals. **They do not**: 0 numeric literals of 7+ digits exist in this file's live (non-comment, pre-self-test) code, and across `scripts/pm/*.mjs` the 47 live-code literals are all provenance citations or measured-evidence records, never a value a reader is told to write. ⇒ The hazard class is not "a literal appears in a script" but "a literal occupies the slot the reader is told to fill in" — and that slot is empty everywhere measured. ⛔ No card owed.
